debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought oscillators (RSI 83.96, Stoch OB, Williams %R OB) combined with VIX crisis regime (342.24), zero fundamental conviction, weak trend strength (ADX 16.35), and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA signal imminent pullback risk that outweighs technical structure.
